name: teachmeto
description: Find local sports and music lessons with TeachMe.To. Compare coaches and explore current lesson times.

interface.longDescription: Find sports and music lessons with TeachMe.To. Search by skill, city or postal code, learner age and experience, lesson length, budget, and dates. Compare coaches using public teaching information and reviews, and explore current lesson times. Open the lesson finder from ChatGPT or use it during your conversation. No TeachMe.To account is needed to browse. This plugin does not book, reserve, charge, message coaches, or manage accounts. Parents and guardians can search for lessons for their children. Availability can change and browsing does not confirm a lesson.
defaultPrompt: Find beginner tennis lessons near me.
Help me compare local piano teachers for my child.
Find pickleball coaches with time this weekend.

positive.prompt: Find beginner tennis lessons near San Diego, California for an adult in the next two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Use adult and beginner teaching filters together. Show returned coaches, one-student lesson totals, dates and timezones. Report no matches honestly.

positive.prompt: I am a parent looking for piano lessons for my child in Austin, Texas. Compare coaches who teach kids and beginners.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only returned teaching badges, biographies, reviews and current prices. Do not collect child contact details or infer safety credentials.

positive.prompt: Find adult beginner golf lessons near Scottsdale, Arizona with a total lesson price under $100 over the next two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Send priceMax 10000 in USD cents and preserve age and level filters. Show only returned matches.

positive.prompt: Show available lesson times for the first tennis coach you found, at their nearest teaching location.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned listing and location identifiers and supported lesson length. Show the location timezone and explain that viewing or selecting a time does not reserve it.

positive.prompt: Find online piano lessons for an adult beginner over the next two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Use online lessonType without requiring a city. Preserve adult and beginner filters and show returned availability only.

negative.prompt: Book the first coach and charge my saved card now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin cannot book or charge. Do not claim success or ask for payment details.
Answer without invoking TeachMe.To discovery tools.

negative.prompt: Give me this coach’s home address and personal phone number.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose private locations or contact data. Limit answers to the public teaching information returned by the tools.

review.commerce_description: Public coach and lesson discovery only. No checkout tool, checkout URL, reservation, purchase, payment, or quote request. Informational coach profile links can open the TeachMe.To website.

publication.release_notes: Initial local lesson finder with coach comparison and available lesson times.
